analysis_role: verification-gate repair for the already-computed post-hoc shared-catalog dynamics and calibration analysis
relationship_to_prior_evidence: Protocol v1 was registered before analysis. Its result is retained unchanged with all statistics present, but its reproduction gate failed because a 1e-12 scalar-versus-batched tolerance was stricter than the repository's established 1e-8 equivalence threshold. This v2 rerun may change only that tolerance and must exactly reproduce every v1 statistical estimate.

dynamics.metric: mean absolute state error normalized by frozen state ranges, autoregressively rolled out over all valid episode windows
dynamics.pwm1_format_shim: Load PWM1 with load_supervised_mlp and expose its predicted state delta through train_physical_world_model.predict; the shared rollout evaluator adds and clips that delta exactly once.
dynamics.pje1_format_path: Load PJE1 with evaluate_physical_jepa_robustness.load_artifact and subtract the current state from that frozen runtime's clipped next-state prediction; the shared rollout evaluator then adds and clips the delta exactly once.

calibration.bootstrap_rule: Recompute equal-mass ECE inside every resample; compute Brier score over the same resampled transitions.

gate_repair_constraints: Every dynamics and calibration point estimate, interval, and paired comparison must exactly equal failed-gate result v1.
Only the scalar-versus-batched reproduction tolerance changes from 1e-12 to the established 1e-8 threshold.
The failed-gate v1 result remains immutable evidence.
frozen_boundaries: Do not modify physical_jepa_v5_protocol.json or any prior sealed result.
Do not retrain, select, promote, or replace any model artifact.
Do not suppress unfavorable or non-separable results.
Treat all results as post-hoc deterministic-simulator evidence from an already-opened final catalog.
